package rulefixtures

import "strings"

// scenario for len_string_for_empty_check: `len(s) == 0` used interchangeably with `s == ""`
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: info.

func scenario611Positive(input string) string {
	if len(input) == 0 {
		return "default"
	}
	if len(strings.TrimSpace(input)) == 0 {
		return "whitespace"
	}
	return input
}

func validateName(name string) bool {
	return len(name) > 0
}
